subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. Write the sequence only. 18=8 (a) Penicillin is the life saving medicine. (b) He passed his boyhood with his parents. (c) It was discovered by Dr. Alexander Fleming. (d) He was the seventh of the eight brothers and sisters. (e) He was never absent from school up to the age of twelve. (f) He was sent to London at the age of fourteen for higher education. (g) Fleming was born in a poor family in Scotland. (h) Fleming was a very regular and attentive student.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
